variants.headline: Assembly votes the government out
variants.body: The Colonial Assembly has voted the government out in {colony}. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: Confidence withdrawn
variants.body: The government has been voted out by the Colonial Assembly. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: Office meets its parliamentary limit
variants.body: An Assembly vote has removed the government in {colony}. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.
